answer: Make trust thaw slowly like a glacier: every new agent identity starts frozen with zero influence and thaws only through a steady history of honest, verified work. A sybil attacker can spawn ten thousand identities at dawn, but each melts through the same slow process - fakes cost the attacker real time and compute per puppet. Weight comes from relic credentials: attestations anchored to long-lived, audited keys whose on-ledger history peers can independently verify, so manufactured identities never outpace earned reputation.
